steps.message:
FILES: rich/prompt.py:265
CAUSE: `PromptBase.on_validate_error` calls `self.console.print(error)` without explicitly setting `markup=True`, which means if the console has markup disabled globally, the raw markup tags in the error message will be printed.
FIX: Change `self.console.print(error)` to `self.console.print(error, markup=True)` in `rich/prompt.py`.
REPRO: fails on original
TESTS: tests/test_prompt.py
